tools.name: create_workspace

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_brands(id,organization_id,name,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :brand_id,:organization_id,:brand_name,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND status='active' AND length(trim(:organization_id))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_id))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands WHERE id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'owner',:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'workspace.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:__user_id AND role='owner') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_applications

tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,COALESCE((SELECT s.profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_linkedin_application
tools.description: Record a LinkedIn sourced candidate and application with basis, contact context, assignment and audit
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,linkedin_profile_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),''),''),NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),''),:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND (NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),'') IS NULL OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://www.linkedin.com/%' OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://linkedin.com/%') AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'LinkedIn sourced',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.description: Change application stage with optimistic version, reason, history and audit
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=:to_stage,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND stage=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND :to_stage IN ('in_review','interviewing','decision_pending','offered','hired','rejected','withdrawn') AND :to_stage<>:from_stage AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND :from_stage IN ('submitted','in_review','interviewing','decision_pending','offered') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_stage,:to_stage,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND a.stage=:to_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.stage_changed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_assignment_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_user_id,to_user_id,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_user_id,:to_user_id,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND a.assignee_user_id=:to_user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_outbox(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id,logical_email_id) SELECT :draft_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:recipient_email,:subject,:body,'draft',:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id,:__uuid FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.email=:recipient_email AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'communication.draft_created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_outbox WHERE id=:draft_id AND application_id=:application_id AND status='draft' AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: record_candidate_email
tools.description: Append an immutable, full-content Gmail record after an agent receives or sends candidate email; this does not send email Optional logical_email_id requires the exact scoped send claimant; conflicting links abort. Existing unlinked archives remain immutable; zero changes requires readback, never means success.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at,logical_email_id) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'gmail',:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(trim(:provider_thread_id),''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now,:logical_email_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id))>0 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: record_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Append a full-content Cloudflare email-worker candidate email after an actual read/send; never sends mail. Keep the bridge message/thread IDs opaque and record Cloudflare receipt/event IDs separately when available. mailbox_address must equal inbound To or outbound From. Zero inserted rows means replay/conflict/refusal, never a newly archived message; verify using get_worker_candidate_email. Optional logical_email_id requires the exact scoped send claimant; conflicting links abort. Existing unlinked archives remain immutable; zero changes requires readback, never means success.

hiring_worker_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at,logical_email_id) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'email-worker','cloudflare',lower(trim(:mailbox_address)),COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''),:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(:provider_thread_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_receipt_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_event_id,''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now,:logical_email_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:communication_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:mailbox_address)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:mailbox_address,'@')>1 AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_thread_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_receipt_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_event_id,''))<=2000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND changes()=1

tools.name: get_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Read back one Cloudflare email-worker record by exact operation ID for a granted application; verify stored provider, mailbox and opaque IDs before treating a replay as recorded. Does not contact Cloudflare or verify delivery.
tools.sql: SELECT e.logical_email_id,e.id,e.direction,e.channel,e.provider,e.mailbox_address,e.provider_connection_id,e.from_email,e.to_email,e.subject,e.body,e.provider_message_id,e.provider_thread_id,e.provider_receipt_id,e.provider_event_id,e.occurred_at,e.actor_user_id,e.agent_instance_id,e.operation_id,e.created_at FROM hiring_worker_communication_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) LIMIT 1

statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_agent_activity(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,activity_type,source_url,summary,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :activity_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:activity_type,:source_url,:summary,:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND :activity_type IN ('candidate_profile_crawled','candidate_search_crawled','email_thread_scanned') AND :source_url LIKE 'https://%' AND length(trim(:summary))>0 AND length(:summary)<=5000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'agent.' || :activity_type,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_agent_activity WHERE id=:activity_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.description: List inbound and outbound Gmail and Cloudflare email-worker records for a granted application, preserving their real provider and receipt IDs
tools.sql: SELECT logical_email_id,id,direction,channel,'gmail' AS provider,NULL AS mailbox_address,NULL AS provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,NULL AS provider_receipt_id,NULL AS provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) UNION ALL SELECT logical_email_id,id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT 100

tools.name: gateway_list_applications
tools.description: Gateway: paginated, redacted applications for a granted brand. Keyset cursor (cursor_at, cursor_id); 25 per page; no contact details or free text
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,a.stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR a.updated_at < :cursor_at OR (a.updated_at = :cursor_at AND a.id > :cursor_id)) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 25

tools.name: gateway_get_application
tools.description: Gateway: one redacted application for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,a.stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND a.id=:application_id LIMIT 1

tools.description: Gateway: one requisition for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row

tools.name: publish_job_requisition
tools.description: Publish immutable job and notice snapshot. Brand owner and recent app passkey step-up required; never use a model confirmation flag.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_job_publications(requisition_id,organization_id,brand_id,description,location,arrangement,compensation,notice_version,notice_text,contact,compensation_type,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:description,:location,:arrangement,:compensation,:notice_version,:notice_text,:contact,coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified'),:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND length(trim(:arrangement)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:compensation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_version)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:notice_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:contact)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified') IN ('unspecified','paid','unpaid','internship','volunteer') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisition_reviews v WHERE v.requisition_id=r.id AND (v.state!='pending_review' OR v.payload!=json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified'))))

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.published',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.description: Close publication with version and audit; legacy draft requisition remains compatible.

tools.name: list_public_jobs
tools.description: Public published job summaries only; use after_id for pagination.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.organization_id,j.brand_id,r.title,i.brand_name,i.organization_name,j.location,j.created_at FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_publication_identities i ON i.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=j.brand_id AND b.organization_id=j.organization_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND o.status='active' AND (:after_id='' OR j.requisition_id>:after_id) ORDER BY j.requisition_id LIMIT 25

tools.name: get_public_job
tools.description: Public approved job/notice snapshot; no candidate or internal fields.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.organization_id,j.brand_id,r.title,i.brand_name,i.organization_name,j.description,j.location,j.arrangement,j.compensation,j.compensation_type,j.notice_version,j.notice_text,j.contact,j.version FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_publication_identities i ON i.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=j.brand_id AND b.organization_id=j.organization_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND o.status='active' AND j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: save_my_worker_profile
tools.description: Create or update only your independent worker profile. Never grants staff access.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_worker_profiles(user_id,display_name,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :__user_id,:display_name,:__now,:__now WHERE length(trim(:display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name=excluded.display_name,updated_at=excluded.updated_at

tools.name: get_my_worker_profile
tools.description: Read your worker profile only.
tools.sql: SELECT display_name,created_at,updated_at FROM hiring_worker_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: submit_job_application
tools.description: Candidate-facing intake: signed-in candidate, no recruiter membership required. Exact published scope, honeypot, validation, per-candidate rate limits, candidate/requisition deduplication and atomic consent/receipt/history/audit.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,created_by,created_at,worker_user_id) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,lower(trim(:email)),NULLIF(:phone,''),'',:__user_id,:__now,:__user_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_runtime_gate WHERE id=1 AND intake_status='open') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND idempotency_key=:idempotency_key) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-86400000)<10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-10000) AND COALESCE(:website,'')='' AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL AND length(:candidate_name)<=200 AND instr(:candidate_name,char(0))=0 AND :email=trim(:email) AND :email NOT GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' AND instr(:email,char(0))=0 AND length(:email)-length(replace(:email,'@',''))=1 AND length(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1))>=3 AND instr(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1),'.')>1 AND substr(:email,-1)<>'.' AND instr(:phone,char(0))=0 AND instr(:statement,char(0))=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND length(:application_id)<=128 AND instr(:application_id,char(0))=0 AND length(:candidate_id)<=128 AND instr(:candidate_id,char(0))=0 AND length(:idempotency_key)<=128 AND instr(:idempotency_key,char(0))=0 AND length(:operation_id)<=128 AND instr(:operation_id,char(0))=0

INSERT INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at,submitted_snapshot_json,notice_version,idempotency_key) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin','Direct application',:notice_version,'Candidate supplied', (SELECT user_id FROM hiring_effective_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND role='owner' AND requisition_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,user_id LIMIT 1),'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now,json_object('name',:candidate_name,'email',lower(trim(:email)),'phone',:phone,'statement',:statement,'notice_version',:notice_version,'publication_version',:expected_version,'notice_acknowledged',:notice_acknowledged,'talent_pool_consent',:talent_pool_consent,'communications_consent',:communications_consent,'requisition_id',:requisition_id,'brand_id',:brand_id,'organization_id',:organization_id),:notice_version,:idempotency_key WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND worker_user_id=:__user_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_intake_receipts(application_id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,worker_user_id,idempotency_key,payload_json,created_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:__user_id,:idempotency_key,json_object('name',:candidate_name,'email',lower(trim(:email)),'phone',:phone,'statement',:statement,'notice_version',:notice_version,'publication_version',:expected_version,'notice_acknowledged',:notice_acknowledged,'talent_pool_consent',:talent_pool_consent,'communications_consent',:communications_consent,'requisition_id',:requisition_id,'brand_id',:brand_id,'organization_id',:organization_id),:__now WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND created_by=:__user_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_consent_records(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,purpose,legal_basis,notice_version,evidence_reference,actor_user_id,recorded_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application_notice','contract',:notice_version,json_object('affirmative_action','application_submit','notice_text',j.notice_text,'publication_version',j.version),:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND changes()=1

INSERT INTO hiring_consent_records(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,purpose,legal_basis,notice_version,evidence_reference,actor_user_id,recorded_at) SELECT :operation_id||':'||p.purpose,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,p.purpose,'consent',:notice_version,'Optional unchecked checkbox selected at submission',:__user_id,:__now FROM (SELECT 'talent_pool' AS purpose,:talent_pool_consent AS selected UNION ALL SELECT 'communications',:communications_consent) p WHERE p.selected=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_consent_records WHERE id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND application_id=:application_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'Candidate submitted',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_consent_records WHERE id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.submitted',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_my_application_receipt
tools.description: Read original receipt for authenticated retry reconciliation; compare payload before treating replay as success.
tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.payload_json,r.created_at,a.stage FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND r.idempotency_key=:idempotency_key LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_job_applications
tools.description: Candidate-owned applications; excludes staff notes, contact provenance and other candidates.
tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.created_at,a.stage,q.title,b.name AS brand_name FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions q ON q.id=r.requisition_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.application_id LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_application_attachment
tools.description: Reserve private uploader-scoped object path; pending scan, never a reviewer download authorization. Metadata is unverified until trusted scanner integration.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_attachments(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,uploader_user_id,filename,storage_path,mime_type,size_bytes,checksum,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :attachment_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:__user_id,:filename,'intake/'||:attachment_id,:mime_type,:size_bytes,:checksum,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(:attachment_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :attachment_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9-]*' AND length(trim(:filename)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND :mime_type IN ('application/pdf','text/plain') AND :size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND length(:checksum)=64 AND :checksum NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE application_id=:application_id AND scan_state<>'deleted')<3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_attachments WHERE id=:attachment_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: list_application_attachments
tools.description: Attachment metadata for uploader or exact assigned brand member; private paths never returned.
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.filename,x.mime_type,x.size_bytes,x.scan_state,x.uploader_user_id,x.created_at FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.scan_state<>'deleted' AND (x.uploader_user_id=:__user_id OR (a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))))) ORDER BY x.created_at LIMIT 3

tools.name: delete_application_attachment
tools.description: Uploader tombstones attachment before deleting their private object; downloads must refuse tombstones. Retriable object cleanup uses deterministic path.
statements: UPDATE hiring_attachments SET scan_state='deleted',deleted_at=:__now WHERE id=:attachment_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND uploader_user_id=:__user_id AND scan_state<>'deleted' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.deleted',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_application_attachment
tools.description: Clean attachment authorization only; no storage capability URL. Trusted scan and reviewer byte-serving integration still required.
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.filename,x.mime_type,x.size_bytes,x.checksum FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.id=:attachment_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.scan_state='clean' AND (x.uploader_user_id=:__user_id OR (a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))))) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_job_publications
tools.description: Staff publication state for an exact granted brand, including closed jobs.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.version,CASE WHEN j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) THEN 'paused' ELSE 'published' END AS status,r.title FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id WHERE j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: grant_workspace_access
tools.description: grant workspace access
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_grants(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,user_id,role,granted_by,created_at) SELECT :grant_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:member_user_id,:role,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :role IN ('recruiter','reviewer','auditor') AND :member_user_id<>:__user_id AND length(trim(:member_user_id))>0 AND length(trim(:grant_id))>0 AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:grant_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'grant.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'grant',:grant_id WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: revoke_workspace_grant
tools.description: revoke workspace grant
statements: UPDATE hiring_grants SET status='revoked' WHERE id=:grant_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND (brand_id=:brand_id OR (brand_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND status='active'))) AND status='active' AND user_id<>:__user_id AND role<>'owner' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'grant.revoked',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'grant',:grant_id WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: revoke_workspace_membership
tools.description: revoke workspace membership
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_membership_revocations(membership_id,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT id,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:grant_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_membership_revocations WHERE membership_id=:grant_id) AND user_id<>:__user_id AND role<>'owner' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'membership.revoked',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'grant',:grant_id WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.description: Owner lists scoped grants for this brand

tools.description: Organization creator grants access across its brands, audited under an owned brand
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_grants(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,user_id,role,granted_by,created_at) SELECT :grant_id,:organization_id,NULL,NULL,:member_user_id,:role,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :role IN ('recruiter','reviewer','auditor') AND :member_user_id<>:__user_id AND length(trim(:member_user_id))>0 AND length(trim(:grant_id))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND status='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:grant_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'grant.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'grant',:grant_id WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: queue_communication
tools.description: outbox.queued; atomic scoped outbox transition, no provider call
statements: UPDATE hiring_outbox SET logical_email_id=COALESCE(logical_email_id,:__uuid),delivery_state='pending',idempotency_key=operation_id WHERE id=:draft_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND delivery_state='draft' AND operation_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.queued',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.queued' WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id)))

tools.name: claim_communication
tools.description: outbox.claimed; atomic scoped outbox transition, no provider call
statements: UPDATE hiring_outbox SET delivery_state='sending',claim_id=:operation_id,claimed_by=:__user_id,attempt_count=attempt_count+1,last_attempt_at=:__now WHERE id=:draft_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND delivery_state='pending'

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.claimed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.claimed' WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id)))

tools.sql: SELECT m.id,m.user_id,m.role,'brand' AS scope_type,m.brand_id AS scope_id,m.brand_id,NULL AS requisition_id,m.created_at AS granted_at,'membership' AS source FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_membership_revocations r WHERE r.membership_id=m.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations o WHERE o.id=:organization_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT g.id,g.user_id,g.role,CASE WHEN g.requisition_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'requisition' WHEN g.brand_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'brand' ELSE 'organization' END,coalesce(g.requisition_id,g.brand_id,g.organization_id),g.brand_id,g.requisition_id,g.created_at,'grant' FROM hiring_grants g WHERE g.organization_id=:organization_id AND g.status='active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations o WHERE o.id=:organization_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY granted_at,id LIMIT 500

tools.name: save_requisition_review
tools.description: Owner saves draft or submits exact job and notice for review. Version zero creates; pending review may return to draft. No legal-review gate per owner decision #52.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_requisition_reviews(requisition_id,state,payload,actor_user_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:state,json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified')),:__user_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :state IN ('draft','pending_review') AND :compensation_type IN ('paid','unpaid','internship','volunteer') AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:arrangement)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:compensation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_version)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:contact)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT version FROM hiring_requisition_reviews WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) ON CONFLICT(requisition_id) DO UPDATE SET state=excluded.state,payload=excluded.payload,actor_user_id=excluded.actor_user_id,version=version+1

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'requisition.review_saved',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'requisition',:requisition_id WHERE changes()=1

statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,linkedin_profile_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),'',NULL,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:source)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (:profile_url IS NULL OR trim(:profile_url)='' OR (length(:profile_url)<=2000 AND (:profile_url LIKE 'https://%' OR :profile_url LIKE 'http://%')))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:source)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (:profile_url IS NULL OR trim(:profile_url)='' OR (length(:profile_url)<=2000 AND (:profile_url LIKE 'https://%' OR :profile_url LIKE 'http://%')))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'Candidate added from '||trim(:source),:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: savePDDraft
tools.description: Append a scoped structured PD version before publication. Editing resets pending publication review to draft; owner must review again. Expected version and operation ID prevent lost updates and duplicate writes.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_pd_versions(requisition_id,version,payload,actor_user_id,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT r.id,:expected_version+1,json_object('overview',:overview,'rolePurpose',:rolePurpose,'responsibilities',json(:responsibilities),'requirements',json(:requirements),'workingArrangement',:workingArrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'benefits',:benefits,'applicationProcess',:applicationProcess,'privacyContact',:privacyContact),:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND length(:overview)<=20000 AND length(:rolePurpose)<=20000 AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:responsibilities) THEN json_type(:responsibilities)='array' AND json_array_length(:responsibilities)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:responsibilities) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:requirements) THEN json_type(:requirements)='array' AND json_array_length(:requirements)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:requirements) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND length(:workingArrangement)<=20000 AND length(:compensation)<=20000 AND length(:benefits)<=20000 AND length(:applicationProcess)<=20000 AND length(:privacyContact)<=20000

tools.name: listVacancies
tools.description: Public approved vacancy and immutable structured PD snapshot only. Missing or unavailable detail returns no rows (NOT_FOUND).
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.organization_id,j.brand_id,r.title,i.brand_name,i.organization_name,j.location,j.created_at,j.arrangement,j.description,j.compensation,pd.payload AS pd_json,pd.pd_version,'published' AS status FROM hiring_job_publications j LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_publications pd ON pd.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_publication_identities i ON i.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=j.brand_id AND b.organization_id=j.organization_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND o.status='active' AND (:organization_id IS NULL OR :organization_id='' OR j.organization_id=:organization_id) AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR :brand_id='' OR j.brand_id=:brand_id) AND (:after_id='' OR j.requisition_id>:after_id) ORDER BY j.requisition_id LIMIT 25

tools.name: getVacancyDetail
tools.description: Public approved vacancy and immutable structured PD snapshot only. Missing or unavailable detail returns no rows (NOT_FOUND).
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.organization_id,j.brand_id,r.title,i.brand_name,i.organization_name,j.description,j.location,j.arrangement,j.compensation,j.compensation_type,j.notice_version,j.notice_text,j.contact,j.version,pd.payload AS pd_json,pd.pd_version,'published' AS status FROM hiring_job_publications j LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_publications pd ON pd.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_publication_identities i ON i.requisition_id=j.requisition_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=j.brand_id AND b.organization_id=j.organization_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.status='published' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND o.status='active' AND j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: listVacancyManagement
tools.description: Recent 100 scoped requisitions with derived review/publication lifecycle and latest activity time; no candidates.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' WHEN v.state='pending_review' THEN 'in review' ELSE 'draft' END AS state, max(r.created_at,coalesce(j.created_at,0),coalesce(d.updated_at,0),coalesce((SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id AND a.object_id=r.id),0)) AS updated_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_requisition_reviews v ON v.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_versions d ON d.requisition_id=r.id AND d.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id) WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,r.id LIMIT 100
